purpose: Train the high-capacity off-device VARDHANI specialist teacher only after exact corpus recovery and architecture identity are proven. This contract has no promotion or execution authority.

teacher_identity.name: VARDHANI_SPECIALIST_R3_TEACHER_568M_FAMILY
teacher_identity.capacity_target: approximately 568M parameters as defined by the sealed V0.2 architecture; exact parameter count must come from the immutable architecture manifest
teacher_identity.rule: No architecture hash or exact parameter count may be invented. Optimizer start is forbidden until the actual architecture manifest and referenced source files are present and hash-verified.

chronology.rule: All optimizer gradients, normalization fits, class/target statistics, prototype selection and episodic-memory fitting must use development data dated no later than 2024-12-31. 2025 may be read only by evaluation/calibration procedures explicitly marked validation-only and may never update teacher weights. 2026 is not readable by the historical teacher pipeline.

minimum_streams: India VIX causally available state when genuine archived data exists
forming and completed 3m state reconstructed causally
forming and completed 5m state reconstructed causally
forming and completed 15m context reconstructed causally
cross-index synchronized state only at timestamps causally available for both indices

india_vix.rule: Use exact or causally as-of genuine archived VIX state only. If unavailable at a timestamp, set the VIX modality-present mask false; never backfill from future values.

nifty_options.source: reconstructed aiml-historical-option-row-v1 plus genuine raw option OHLC/volume/OI where required
nifty_options.rule: Attach only at exact timestamps where genuine option state is available. Earlier market history without genuine options remains valid full-market experience with option_present=false.

pcr.rule: Any derived PCR must identify its actual archived contract universe. A partial/local CE/PE OI ratio may not be labelled as full-market PCR. Missing coverage is masked, not synthesized.

allowed_proxies: causal activity/turnover proxies derived from genuine bars

multi_timeframe_authority.rule: 15m may enrich context/state interpretation but may not become a mechanical veto that overrides lower-timeframe judgement. Any action head path from a separately isolated 15m context branch must satisfy the precommitted architecture contract and non-veto audit.

teacher_learning_targets: future return distributions for 1m/3m/5m/10m/15m where exact targets are valid
target-before-stop probability under separately versioned economic definitions
NIFTY CE/PE relative-behavior state where genuine options exist
historical analogue embedding suitable for episodic retrieval

checkpoint_contract.best_checkpoint_selection_data: 2025 validation only, under a predeclared selection metric contained in the architecture/training manifest

episodic_memory.teacher_memory_build: development/train-only states and labels may be used to construct historical experience memory
episodic_memory.live_retrieval_rule: At inference, query keys may contain only information available at the current timestamp. Retrieved outcome metadata must not be exposed as an input channel in a way that leaks future information unavailable live.

hard_prohibitions: Do not modify, retrain or overwrite frozen R2.
Do not train the R3 teacher without the exact recovery unlock token.
Do not invent the V0.2 architecture hash or exact parameter count.
Do not use 2025 rows for optimizer gradients or train-stat fitting.
Do not read 2026 historical rows in teacher training or validation.
Do not fabricate missing options, VIX, bid/ask, depth, Greeks, D30, index volume or index OI.
Do not call a partial option OI ratio full-market PCR.
Do not promote from historical results alone.
Do not enable real broker orders.
